question: to the Commission Ana Miranda Paz (Verts/ALE) Subject:

According to data from the European Forest Fire Information System (EFFIS), almost 200 000 hectares burned in Galicia in the summer of 2025, making the autonomous community one of the most heavily affected regions in Europe. The Galician Government’s failure to take preventive action resulted in a lack of response to this tragedy, with the fires laying waste to many productive areas and homes, as well as a lot of infrastructure, particularly in the province of Ourense. Moreover, as the Galician delegation informed the Commission’s Director-General for the Environment at a meeting a few weeks ago, the restoration plans have not been fulfilled, with only 6 000 hectares having been restored. In view of the above: 1.
Will the Commission urge the Galician Government to restore the areas affected by the fires?
What EU funds has the Galician Government used to restore the areas that burned in 2025?
